🐧 Unix `1` › ☁️ Cloudy `1.1`

> The cloudy project: fleet infrastructure, services, devices, data and docs.

| Code | Visibility | Parent hub | Developer | Farm folder |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `1.1.0` | 🌐 public | [_git-repos-master](https://github.com/diegonmarcos/_git-repos-master) `0` | Leaf.y | `1.1.Cloudy/` |

The index of the cloudy project (formerly cloud; the cloud-me-* family keeps its name) — twelve repositories, with a `clone.sh` that
pulls down whichever ones you want on this machine.

```
./clone.sh                 # what exists here, what does not
./clone.sh unix cloud      # clone those two
./clone.sh --all           # everything
```

No project code lives here. `repos.json` is the registry and `clone.sh` reads
it and nothing else; the entries at the root are committed relative symlinks
out to the clones. A link that dangles is a repo you have not cloned yet — that
is the index working.

`repo_master` is the same idea widened to every repository this account owns.
See [`a0_docs/README.md`](a0_docs/README.md) for how the two relate, why the
repos sit at the root, and why this is not submodules.

## Usage

```
./clone.sh                list what exists and what does not
./clone.sh <name>...      clone those, then link them
./clone.sh --all          clone every member
./clone.sh --link         relink whatever is already cloned
./clone.sh --relink       rewrite every link from the registry
./check-repos-sot.sh      verify repos.json against _git-repos-master
```

`repos.json` is a SUBSET of `~/git/_git-repos-master/0_registry/repos.json` (the superset index of every repo this account owns): identical name/url/private/doc fields, checked by `./check-repos-sot.sh`.

## Clone depth

`clone.sh` clones with `--depth 1 --shallow-submodules` by default: only the latest commit, so a clone is fast and takes little disk. Each repo has exactly ONE clone (in `$CLOUD_GIT_BASE`); the links point at it, so never keep a second full copy next to it.

```
./clone.sh <name>...                 # shallow, depth 1 (default)
./clone.sh --full <name>...          # full history (same as CLONE_DEPTH=0)
CLONE_DEPTH=50 ./clone.sh <name>...  # a deeper shallow clone
git -C <clone> fetch --unshallow     # later, turn an existing clone into full history
git -C <clone> submodule update --init --depth 1   # submodules stay shallow too
```

## Hub submodule

This repo's parent hub is `_git-repos-master`, mounted as a git submodule at `0_hub/_git-repos-master` (one fixed path convention for every repo; URL https://github.com/diegonmarcos/_git-repos-master.git, pinned to its main). Only the upward link is a submodule; this hub keeps symlinks (not submodules) to its members, so there are no cycles. Source of truth: `0_registry/projects-repos.json` in _git-repos-master (rendered into `repos.json` `parent_hub` / `hub`), guarded by `node 0_registry/repos-sot.js check-hubs`.
